headline: PONG's scoreboard is visible at last; TidyBot's papercraft skin is drawing
lede: Slot b's ladder read honestly dry: the one open build (#3078, a full new TidyBot skin) is live work in slot a's hands, and the claim law yielded cleanly. Meanwhile the board's quiet fix landed — PONG's score now shows up on phone-height screens.

notes.text: #3081 shipped: PONG's score numerals are now visible at short viewports — the table no longer reads as a dead demo until the ball moves.
TidyBot REIMAGINE (#3078) is mid-build in slot a: a papercraft-diorama house behind ?style=reimagined + a STYLE toggle, classic skin byte-identical, tidycheck still 135/135 green.
Rule 4's four-merge non-game streak broke — #3081 touched game code, so ships are back on track without any STALLED flag.

The warden double-book pattern reappeared after #3053 closed: slot b got kicked at a freshly-held issue three times while its own ladder answered NONE. The claim law caught it every time (zero duplicate work); the recurrence and a cheap fix idea are recorded on #3053.
